WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00021.retireveValidateCalcSetData */ payroll_calculation_set_id , payroll_calculation_set_name , resignation_flag , payroll_type_code FROM tb_pay_calc_set_n WHERE 1=1 /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND payroll_calculation_set_id NOT IN SELECT #{deleteItem.payrollCalculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS payroll_calculation_set_id FROM dual ) , rs AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{createItem.payrollCalculationSetId}) AS payroll_calculation_set_id , #{createItem.payrollCalculationSetName} AS payroll_calculation_set_name , #{createItem.resignationFlag} AS resignation_flag , #{createItem.payrollTypeCode} AS payroll_type_code FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT NVL(update_list.payroll_calculation_set_id , detail_list.payroll_calculation_set_id ) AS payroll_calculation_set_id , NVL(update_list.payroll_calculation_set_name , detail_list.payroll_calculation_set_name ) AS payroll_calculation_set_name , NVL(update_list.resignation_flag , detail_list.resignation_flag ) AS resignation_flag , NVL(update_list.payroll_type_code , detail_list.payroll_type_code ) AS payroll_type_code FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{updated[${idx}].payrollCalculationSetId}) AS payroll_calculation_set_id , #{updated[${idx}].payrollCalculationSetName} AS payroll_calculation_set_name , #{updated[${idx}].resignationFlag} AS resignation_flag , #{updated[${idx}].payrollTypeCode} AS payroll_type_code FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_calculation_set_id = update_list.payroll_calculation_set_id(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_calculation_set_id , detail_list.payroll_calculation_set_name , detail_list.resignation_flag , detail_list.payroll_type_code FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.payroll_calculation_set_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.payroll_calculation_set_name) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) FROM rs GROUP BY rs.payroll_calculation_set_name HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_calc_set_names /* Calculation Set Name 중복 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.calculationSet' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_calc_set_names_title FROM dual
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00021.insertCalcSet */ INTO tb_pay_calc_set_n( payroll_calculation_set_id /* 급여산출세트아이디 */ , payroll_calculation_set_name /* 급여산출세트명 */ , subsidiary_code /* 해외법인코드 */ , resignation_flag /* 퇴직여부 */ , payroll_type_code /* 급여유형코드 */ , object_type /* object_type */ -- vanaa 03/11/2025 , auto_creation_flag /* 자동생성여부 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date /* 최종수정일자 */ , last_update_user_id /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( sq_tb_pay_calc_set_n.nextval /* payroll_calculation_set_id => 급여산출세트아이디 */ , #{payrollCalculationSetName} /* payroll_calculation_set_name => 급여산출세트명 */ , #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* subsidiary_code => 해외법인코드 */ , #{resignationFlag} /* resignation_flag => 퇴직여부 */ , #{payrollTypeCode} /* payroll_type_code => 급여유형코드 */ , #{objectType} /* object_type => object_type */ -- vanaa 03/11/2025 , #{autoCreationFlag} /* auto_creation_flag => 자동생성여부 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* last_update_date => 최종수정일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* last_update_user_id => 최종수정사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00021.updateCalcSet */ tb_pay_calc_set_n SET payroll_calculation_set_name = #{payrollCalculationSetName} /* 급여산출세트명 */ , resignation_flag = #{resignationFlag} /* 퇴직여부 */ , payroll_type_code = #{payrollTypeCode} /* 급여유형코드 */ , object_type = #{objectType} /* objectType */ -- vanaa 03/11/2025 , auto_creation_flag = #{autoCreationFlag} /* 자동생성여부 */ , last_update_date = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일자 */ , last_update_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ WHERE payroll_calculation_set_id = #{payrollCalculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여산출세트아이디 */ AND subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAY00021.deleteCalcSet */ FROM tb_pay_calc_set_n WHERE payroll_calculation_set_id = #{payrollCalculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여산출세트아이디 */ AND subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */
